Taco: The magic marker is in a safe place.
Maxie: I know.
Maxie: But what if the witch finds it!
Maxie: Taco! We must get the magic marker back!
Taco: Oh, Maxie. Do we have to?
Maxie: Yes, Taco. Come on.
Maxie: Let's get the marker.

episodes.title: We Need the Magic Marker Again

subtitle.text: Maxie: Betty! Betty!
Betty: Hi, Maxie! Hi, Taco! What's up?
Maxie: We need the magic marker again!
Betty: The magic marker? But why?
Taco: It's a long story.
Taco: Anyway, we want the marker back.
Taco: Maxie! The crocodile!
Taco: Jack is gone!
Taco: He's gone!
Maxie: Betty, where is Jack?
Betty: I'm sorry, Maxie.
Betty: Jack is going to a new zoo.
Betty: We had a party for him yesterday.
Maxie: But he has our marker!
Taco: Where is he going?
Betty: I don't know.
Betty: Wait! Look over there!
Betty: That's Jack! He's inside the truck!
Taco: Come on, Maxie! Let's go!
Maxie: The truck is going too fast!
Maxie: We'll never catch up!
Taco: Maxie! I think Jack is using your magic marker.
Maxie: We have to get that marker before the witch does.
Maxie: Taco! Hurry! Follow that truck!
Taco: I'm trying, Maxie.
Taco: I'm trying to fly faster.
Maxie: Oh, it's moving again.
Maxie: We'll never catch up.
Maxie: The marker is gone forever!
Taco: Don't give up, Maxie! Look!
Taco: Maybe he can help us!
Maxie: Oh, excuse me.
Maxie: We need your help.
Clown: What? I can't hear you.
Taco: CAN YOU HELP US, PLEASE?
Clown: You don't have to shout!
Clown: What can I do for you?
Maxie: There it is!
Maxie: Follow that truck!
Clown: We're almost there. Hang on!
Taco: Whoa! Whoa! Slow down.
Taco: I feel sick!
Maxie: THANK YOU VERY MUCH!
Clown: You're welcome.
Clown: I have to get back to the zoo.
Jack: Oh! What are you doing here?
Jack: Would you like some pizza?
Maxie: No, thanks. Give me the magic marker, please.
Jack: No! It's mine now!
Jack: You can't have it back!
Taco: What do we do now, Maxie?
Taco: Maxie! Do something!
Maxie: Jack! That marker isn't yours. It's mine!
Maxie: So please give it back!
Jack: No! Betty gave it to me!
Jack: So it's mine now!
Maxie: Jack! Betty didn't give it to you.
Maxie: She asked you to keep it in a safe place.
Jack: Hmmm . . . What shall I make now?
Jack: Oh, I know!
Jack: I need to get ready for my new home!
Maxie: Where is your new home?
Maxie: Where are you going, Jack?
Jack: Well . . . Hee-hee-hee, hee-hee-hee.
Maxie: Taco! Keep moving!
Jack: Stop that! Hee-hee-hee . . .
Jack: I'll bite . . . ha-ha-HA-HA!
Maxie: Taco! Jack is ticklish.
Maxie: Keep tickling him!
Jack: I'm ticklish! Stop!
Jack: Ha-ha-ha! Whoaaa! HA-HA-HA!
Maxie: There! Now you can't bite us!
Taco: Maxie! The truck is stopping.
Maxie: Where are we, Jack?
Maxie: Where are you going?
Taco: Where?
Maxie: Do you promise not to bite us?
Maxie: Will you be nice?
Jack: Ouch! That hurt!
Jack: My lips are all red now.
Maxie: Where are you going, Jack?
Jack: Me? To my new home in Hawaii!
Maxie: Jack! We need your help.
Jack: No, you were mean to me.
Jack: You closed my mouth!
Taco: But you were going to eat us!
Jack: I was only trying to scare you.
Jack: I don't like eating birds and cats.
Jack: Yuck!
Maxie: Jack, please help us.
Maxie: I'll give you whatever you want.
Jack: Whatever I want? Hmm . . .
Man 1: Come on! Let's get you on the plane.
Maxie: Nobody is here and it's safe.
Taco: Oh boy! PEE-YEW!
Taco: Maxie! We're at the airport!
Maxie: We'd better get out of here, Taco. Jack!
Maxie: Here is what you wanted.
Jack: Great! Thanks, Maxie!
Jack: Now I can dance whenever I like.
Taco: Have fun in Hawaii!
Maxie: Come on, Taco. Let's go!
Taco: Which way do we go, Maxie?
Maxie: This way, Taco!
Maxie: There are some stairs!
Taco: WHEW! That was close!
Taco: I'm scared of planes!
Maxie: Uh, Taco. I think we're in trouble.
Taco: Why?
Flight attendant: Ladies and gentlemen, please fasten your seat belts.
Flight attendant: We are ready to take off.
Maxie and Taco: Uh-oh!
Taco: I've never been on a plane before.
Taco: This is exciting.
Maxie: Taco! We don't know where we're going!
Maxie: How are we going to get back home?
Flight Attendant: What would you like, sir?
Flight Attendant: Chicken or beef?
Man: I'll have the beef.
Maxie: Taco! I have an idea! Come on!
Taco: Maxie! I'm so hungry!
Maxie: It's not your food!
Maxie: Here, I'll make a roll for you.
Taco: Mmmm, the chocolate cake looks good too.
Taco: I love chocolate cake!
Maxie: We need to find a place to hide!
Maxie: Taco! Look! We can hide over there!
Taco: It's so dark in here, Maxie!
Maxie: That's much better.
Maxie: We can stay here until we know what to do.
Taco: Where do you think we're going, Maxie?
Maxie: I don't know, Taco.
Maxie: But I sure do miss Alex and Sue.
Flight attendant: Please return to your seats.
Flight attendant: We are going to land soon.
Flight attendant: Fasten your seatbelts.
Taco: What a long flight!
Maxie: I think we're going to land.
Taco: I wonder where we are?
Flight Attendant: Ladies and gentlemen, we hope you enjoyed your flight.
Flight attendant: Welcome to China!
Maxie and Taco: CHINA?
Maxie: I can't believe we're in China!
Taco: I've always wanted to visit China!
Taco: Look! Chinese pigeons! Hello! Yoo-hoo!
Maxie: What are you doing, Taco?
Taco: Maybe they can help us.
Taco: Hello! My name is Taco.
Maxie: I don't think they understand you, Taco.
Taco: Do you speak English?
Maxie: Let me try. [i@Ni hao.@i]
Pigeon 1 & 2: [i@Ni hao!@i]
Maxie: [i@Nimen hui jiang Yingwen ma?@i]
Taco: What did you say, Maxie?
Taco: What did you say? Teach me!
Maxie: I asked, "Do you speak English?"
Pigeon 2: [i@Bu hui. Wo pengyou hui jiang Yingwen. Nimen deng.@i]
Taco: What did he say?
Maxie: I don't know. I'm looking . . .
Maxie: [i@Pengyou@i] means friend and [i@deng@i] . . . what does that mean?
Taco: Oh, they're back! [i@Ni hao! Ni hao!@i]
Dog: Hey, your Chinese is pretty good!
Maxie: Hello. My name is Maxie and this is Taco.
Taco: Hello.
Dog: I'm Bao Bao.
Dog: It means "precious."
Dog: And of course all dogs are precious.
Maxie: Well, Bao Bao.
Maxie: We need your help.
Bao Bao: What can I do for you?
Taco: We want to go back home.
Bao Bao: Well, your home is far from here . . .
Bao Bao: but maybe I have an idea.
Taco: Wow! Look at all those bicycles!
Bao Bao: There are more bicycles than cars in China.
Taco: Look how fast those bicycles go!
Maxie: Do you want to go for a ride? A bicycle?
Maxie: How about a skateboard?
Bao Bao: Skateboard? Don't be silly!
Bao Bao: Animals can't ride skateboards or bicycles!
Maxie: Sure we can!
Maxie: We can do anything we want!
Maxie: Do you want to try?
Bao Bao: What? How did you do that?
Taco: Maxie! Can you make a skateboard for all of us to ride?
Maxie: I sure can!
Taco: Come on, Bao Bao! It'll be fun!
Bao Bao: No, thank you.
Bao Bao: I'm scared of skateboards.
Maxie: Well, are you scared of flying?
Bao Bao: Flying? I've always wanted to fly.
Bao Bao: But I'm a dog.
Bao Bao: How can I fly?
Taco: This marker can make your wish come true!
Maxie: Hang on! Don't close your eyes, Bao Bao!
Maxie: Look at the beautiful city!
Bao Bao: Oh! I can't look down!
Bao Bao: Oh! I'm flying! I'm flying!
Taco: YIPPIE!
Bao Bao: Look down there! Yoo-hoo!
Bao Bao: That's my friend! LIAN!
Maxie: Let's go and say hello.
Lian: MEOW!
Bao Bao: Lian! It's me, Bao Bao.
Bao Bao: And these are my new friends.
Lian: What is that?
Lian: And where did you come from?
Bao Bao: My friends and I went flying!
Lian: It's magic!
Lian: I can't believe we're flying!
Taco: Maxie! I'm getting tired.
Taco: Can we stop and rest?
Maxie: Sure. Let's go down there!
Taco: Wow! Look at all those stairs!
Maxie: And look how long this road is!
Bao Bao: I don't think this is a road.
Lian: Wait a minute!
Lian: Do you know where we are?
Maxie and Taco: No. Where are we?
Lian: This is the Great Wall of China!
Taco: The Great Wall of China!
Taco: I've heard so much about it.
Taco: How old is this wall?
Bao Bao: It's over 2,000 years old.
Taco: 2,000? That's very old!
Lian: And it's over 6,000 kilometers long.
Taco: I wish I had a camera!
Taco: My friends back home would love to see the Great Wall.
Maxie: Here, Taco. Let's take some pictures!
Taco: Maxie! You're the best!
Taco: Alex and Sue will love these photos!
Lian: Where did you get that marker?
Lian: Can I get one too?
Taco: Okay, everyone. Strike a pose.
Taco: One, two, three, say cheese!
Everyone: Cheese.
Maxie: Thank you so much for showing us around.
Taco: I learned so much!
Taco: China is a beautiful country.
Bao Bao: You're welcome.
Bao Bao: We had a good time too.
Taco: What's that noise?
Lian: It's the dragon dance.
Maxie: Taco! Look at that dragon!
Taco: What are those people doing?
Bao Bao: Some people give money to the dragon for good luck.
Maxie: Oh, can I try? Please?
Taco: But Maxie! That dragon looks scary!
Maxie: Taco! It's not a real dragon.
Maxie: Don't worry.
Lian: The dragon can't see you.
Lian: Here! Let's make a pyramid.
Lian: Fly up here, Taco.
Maxie: Okay, here I come.
Maxie: Wait a minute.
Taco: He's coming! He's coming!
Maxie: Here, dragon!
Maxie: Take this! Here!
Taco: OUCH! Maxie!
Taco: Get your foot off my head.
Taco: Or else we're going to FFFFAAAAAAALLLLLL!
Bao Bao: Is everyone okay?
Maxie: I'm fine, but where is Taco?
Bao Bao: What's this?
Bao Bao: Is this Taco's?
Maxie: Oh no! Taco! I can't believe he's gone!
Lian: Wait! Over there! Look!
Taco: Hey, everyone! I'm doing the dragon dance!
Lian: Taco, do you want to use a fork?
Taco: No, that's okay.
Taco: I'll keep trying it.
Maxie: Taco! Using chopsticks is so easy!
Maxie: Watch me!
Bao Bao: We found a ship that will take you home.
Taco: A ship? Is it like the [i@Titanic@i]?
Maxie: Here, Taco. You'd better use a fork.
Lian: Not quite.
Lian: It's a big cruise ship.
Lian: But I don't know how you can get on board.
Maxie: Don't worry.
Maxie: I'm sure we can find a way.
Bao Bao: We have to leave tonight to get to the port.
Lian: The ship leaves early in the morning.
Lian: So we have to travel all night.
Taco: No problem.
Maxie: Oh no! The magic marker!
Bao Bao: See, Taco?
Bao Bao: You can use chopsticks!
Maxie: I have something for you.
Lian: What is it?
Maxie: It's a surprise.
Maxie: Just sit back and enjoy the show.
Taco: Are you ready?
Bao Bao: Yes, what is it?
Lian and Bao Bao: Oh, how beautiful!
Lian: Thank you so much!
Taco: My wings hurt from flying all night.
Maxie: Don't complain, Taco.
Maxie: This is the only way to get home.
Bao Bao: You can sleep on the ship.
Bao Bao: It's going to take a long time for you to reach home.
Lian: That's the ship.
Lian: That's the one you have to get on.
Taco: There are so many people.
Taco: How will we get on?
Bao Bao: Look over there!
Bao Bao: Some people take their pets on the ship.
Maxie: Good idea. That's how we can get on board, Taco.
Taco: Huh? I don't understand, Maxie.
Taco: That dog is in a cage.
Maxie: Come on. You have to trust me.
Maxie: Take care, Bao Bao and Lian.
Maxie: We're going to miss you.
Bao Bao: We hope to see you again someday.
Taco: Maxie! What are you doing?
Maxie: SHHH! We don't want people to see us.
Dog: That's why I'm barking!
Dog: You're trying to sneak aboard the ship. Woof! Woof!
Maxie: Okay, Taco. Stand still.
Taco: I don't like cages, Maxie!
Maxie: Me neither.
Maxie: But it's the only way we can get on the ship.
Dog: Hey! How did you do that?
Taco: We're not going to tell you because you barked at us!
Dog: I'll give you this bone if you tell me how you did it!
Taco: Yuck! You already ate some!
Maxie: Good-bye, Lian! Good-bye, Bao Bao!
Taco: Good-bye, China!
Taco: How deep do you think the water is, Maxie?
Maxie: I don't know, but I think it's too deep to swim in.
Taco: I've always wanted to see what it's like underwater.
Maxie: Not me! I don't like the water.
Taco: Hey, Maxie! I have a great idea!
Maxie: What is it, Taco?
Taco: Let's go for a swim!
Maxie: Are you crazy?
Maxie: We're in the middle of the ocean!
Taco: I know.
Taco: We can just take a quick swim and come back to the ship.
Taco: Please? Please?
Maxie: I suppose just a short swim.
Taco: Maxie! It's beautiful!
Maxie: Look at those pretty looking things!
Maxie: What are they?
Taco: I don't know.
Maxie: Hee-hee. That tickles!
Taco: Why are they going away?
Maxie: I don't know.
Taco: Maybe they don't like us.
Maxie: Or maybe they sense danger.
Taco: Uh-oh. I think we're in trouble.
Maxie and Taco: SHARK!
Shark: Hmm . . . I've never eaten anything like you before.
Taco: Please, sir, you wouldn't want to eat us.
Taco: We're not very tasty.
Shark: Oh, I think you'll be very tasty.
Shark: Very tasty indeed . . .
Maxie: What's that noise?
Shark: Wait a minute . . .
Shark: Yes! There's a storm coming.
Shark: Today is your lucky day!
Maxie: Lu . . . lu . . . lucky?
Taco: Stt . . . sttttt . . . storm?
Shark: That's right. A huge one is coming this way.
Shark: I have to find a hiding place.
Shark: If I were you, I'd hide too.
Maxie: We have to get back to the ship.
Maxie: Come on, Taco!
Taco: Maxie! Where is the ship?
Maxie: I can't see anything, Taco!
Maxie: Taco! Over there! I think I see our ship!
Taco: It's no use!
Taco: The ship is too far away!
Taco: We'll never make it!
Maxie: Don't give up, Taco!
Maxie: I still have the magic marker!
Taco: Maxie! The ship is still moving too fast for us.
Taco: How do we catch up?
Maxie: I'll put an engine on this boat!
Taco: Faster, Maxie! Faster!
Maxie: Oh, what an adventure!
Taco: Yes, it was!
Taco: But I don't think I'll go swimming for a while.
Taco: Something is not right.
Taco: I don't remember any of these things.
Maxie: Me, neither. Where are all the people?
Taco: I don't know!
Taco: I think we are on a different ship!
Maxie: I think you're right!
Maxie: Oh no! Where is this ship going?
Taco: It's okay, Maxie. Don't cry.
Taco: We'll find our way home somehow.
Maxie: I'm not crying.
Maxie: I thought it was you.
Taco: If it's not me and it's not you . . . then who's crying?
Voice: ME!
Maxie and Taco: YIKES!
Panda: Don't go! Please!
Panda: I'm so lonely!
Maxie: Are you by yourself?
Maxie: Where are the other animals?
Panda: There aren't any other animals.
Panda: I'm all alone.
Taco: Don't cry. We'll be your friends.
Taco: I'm Taco and this is Maxie.
Panda: I'm Lulu. It's nice to meet you.
Maxie: We'll stay with you.
Maxie: Please stop crying.
Lulu: I can't! I'm so sad!
Maxie: Why are you sad?
Lulu: When I was in China,
Lulu: every night I would look outside at the stars and go to sleep.
Lulu: Now, I can't see any stars.
Lulu: I'm so sad!
Taco: There, there. Please stop crying.
Taco: If you can see some stars, will you be happy again?
Lulu: But I'm inside this cage and I'm inside this ship.
Lulu: How can I see the stars?
Maxie: Don't worry. Just close your eyes.
Taco: Maxie! What are you planning to do?
Taco: There's a storm outside.
Taco: She can't see stars tonight!
Maxie: Taco, you should know better by now.
Maxie: Okay, Lulu, you can open your eyes now.
Lulu: Oh, look at the stars!
Lulu: It's amazing! Just like in China!
Taco: Why are you crying now?
Lulu: I'm crying because I'm so happy!
Taco: Maxie, I think we should look around the ship now.
Maxie: You're right, Taco.
Maxie: It was nice meeting you, Lulu.
Maxie: But we have to go.
Lulu: Can I come, please?
Maxie: I don't know, Lulu.
Maxie: You're too big!
Maxie: What if someone sees you out of your cage?
Lulu: But I'd love to see the ocean.
Lulu: I'd love to smell the fresh air . . .
Taco: Okay, okay! Don't cry!
Taco: Maxie! Let her come with us.
Maxie: As long as you are quiet and stay right next to me.
Lulu: I'm free! I'm free!
Lulu: I'm so happy!
Maxie and Taco: LULU! SSSHHHHHH!
Lulu: Just look at the ocean!
Lulu: It's so grand!
Taco: Maxie! This is definitely another ship!
Taco: We are on the wrong ship!
Maxie: There's nothing we can do now, Taco.
Maxie: At least we are safe.
Lulu: Oh, look!
Taco: Land ahoy! Land ahoy!
Lulu: What does that mean?
Taco: It's what sailors say when they see land.
Taco: Land ahoy!
Lulu: Land ahoy!
Man 1: Gotcha! How did you escape!
Man 3: Where did the cat and bird come from?
Man 4: I don't know.
Man 4: I thought we only had a panda bear.
Man 2: Oh well, let's take them too.
Maxie: Taco! Taco! Can you hear me?
Maxie: Are you okay?
Taco: Maxie? What happened?
Taco: Where are we?
Maxie: I don't know.
Maxie: But I think we are on land.
Maxie: Are you okay?
Taco: Yes. Where is Lulu?
Man: Well, little kitty and birdie.
Man: The zoo only wants the panda.
Man: So I don't know what to do with you.
Man: I found this when we caught you.
Man: Maybe I'll keep it.
Taco: Maxie! That man! That man has your marker!
Maxie: I know, Taco! I know.
Maxie: We have to get it back!
Taco: But how?
Maxie: We have to think of a plan.
Taco: Maxie! The keys are sticking out!
Maxie: I see them, Taco.
Maxie: But how do I get them?
Maxie: Oh, here is a paper clip.
Taco: Great idea, Maxie!
Taco: Now all you need is something to put it on!
Maxie: But what? There is nothing here.
Taco: I got it!
Taco: Put that clip around your tail!
Taco: I think it'll reach the keys.
Maxie: My tail? But then I can't see what I'm doing.
Taco: I'll give you directions.
Taco: It's our only chance.
Taco: Come on, Maxie!
Taco: There's no time to lose!
Maxie: Okay. Here goes.
Maxie: OUCH! That hurts!
Taco: Go up a little bit . . . more to the right . . . just a little more.
Maxie: Taco! My tail is getting tired!
Maxie: Hurry up!
Taco: Almost there . . . just a little bit under . . . now pull!
Maxie: We did it!
Taco: We need to get the magic marker!
Maxie: Oh no! What do we do?
Taco: Which one is the magic marker, Maxie?
Maxie: I don't know.
Maxie: Which one is it?
Maxie: They all look the same!
Taco: Don't worry. It's here somewhere.
Maxie: Oh, I hear someone coming!
Maxie: We'd better get out of here . . .
Taco: Here it is! Maxie! Here it is!
Man: Huh? What's going on?
Man: The door is stuck!
Man: Hey, let me in!
Man: What's going on in there?
Maxie: Now let's get out of here before he can open the door!
Taco: Where are we, Maxie?
Maxie: I'm not sure.
Maxie: It looks like a swamp to me!
Taco: A swamp? Uh-oh!
Taco: You know what lives in swamps, don't you?
Maxie: Yes. Crocodiles . . .
Jack: Hey! Fancy meeting you here!
Jack: I thought it was dinnertime!
Taco: Jack? Is that you?
Jack: Ta-da! What brings you to sunny California?
Maxie: California? I thought you were going to Hawaii.
Jack: Me too! But I ended up here.
Jack: That's okay! I like California too!
Jack: So why are you here?
Taco: It's a long story.
Taco: But I am happy to see someone I know.
Maxie: I wonder what happened to Lulu.
Lulu: Did someone say my name?
Lulu: Oh, [i@ni hao@i], Maxie! [i@Ni hao@i], Taco.
Jack: Who's that?
Taco: Lulu is a panda bear.
Taco: We met her on a ship.
Jack: On a ship? Are you joking?
Maxie: No . . . It's a long story.
Jack: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! I can't believe you ended up in China!
Taco: Well, we met some nice friends and saw lots of cool things!
Maxie: We had a great time.
Maxie: But we really need to get back home.
Maxie: It was nice to see you again, Jack.
Maxie: Lulu, take care and enjoy your new home.
Lulu: Thank you. Come and visit us soon.
Jack: Hey, did you bring my marker back?
Maxie: Your marker?
Maxie: Jack! This marker is mine!
Taco: Is there a bus going home?
Maxie: I can't see clearly.
Maxie: That's better.
Taco: So can we take the bus?
Maxie: No, we can't.
Maxie: We have to try the airport.
Maxie: No flights either.
Taco: What should we do?
Maxie: Let's try the train station.
Taco: Well? Is there a train?
Maxie: Yes! Yes! But it's going to leave soon.
Maxie: Come on!
Taco: Is that it?
Taco: Is that our train?
Maxie: Yes, it is!
Maxie: Oh no! We're going to miss it!
Maxie: I have an idea!
Taco: That was a great idea, Maxie.
Maxie: It was nothing.
Maxie: Finally, we're going home!
Taco: I miss Alex and Sue so much!
Maxie: Me too. They must be so worried about us.
Taco: Maybe we should call them!
Maxie: Good idea, Taco!
Woman: . . . so I said, "You take that back!
Woman: I don't want it!"
Taco: I wish she'd get off the phone!
Woman: . . . I know! So that's what I said next!
Woman: And then he . . .
Maxie: I have an idea.
Woman: . . . Well, it's been awful. I just . . .
Woman: EEEKKKKKK! There's a mouse! EEEEK!
Taco: Good work, Maxie!
Taco: Now hurry, before the woman comes back!
Sue: Hello?
Maxie: Sue! It's Maxie!
Sue: Maxie! Where are you?
Sue: We are so worried about you!
Maxie: I'll explain everything soon.
Maxie: Can you pick us up at the train station?
Maxie: We should be there soon.
Sue: Of course! We have a guest here.
Sue: Maybe she can drive us.
Maxie: Okay! We'll see you soon! Bye!
Alex: Well, at least they are safe.
Sue: I'm so glad!
Sue: We have to pick them up now.
Alex: We're very sorry, but can you help us?
Alex: We need to pick up our cat and bird at the train station.
Witch: Oh, your cat and bird.
Witch: I'd be more than happy to help you.
Alex: Thank you so much for helping us.
Witch: Don't mention it.
Witch: What are neighbors for?
Witch: Here we are.
Witch: At last! The marker will be mine again!
Sue: Excuse me?
Witch: Oh, I said, "At last, it is sunny again!"
Taco: Can you see them?
Taco: Can you see Alex and Sue?
Maxie: No, I can't.
Maxie: I can't see them at all.
Taco: Let me have a look.
Taco: I think I see them! It's them!
Taco: But there is a lady with them.
Maxie: Sue said they have a guest.
Maxie: Maybe it's her.
Maxie: Taco! It's her! It's her!
Maxie: It's the witch!
Taco: And the train is almost at the station!
Taco: What do we do?
Maxie: Well, we can't stop at the station!
Maxie: The witch will take the marker from us. Come on!
Maxie: The train can't stop here.
Maxie: We have to do something!
Taco: Maxie! We should press that red button!
Maxie: Press the red button . . . come on . . .
Taco: You can do it, Maxie!
Taco: You can do it!
Taco and Maxie: WHOA!
Alex: What is going on?
Alex: Why isn't the train stopping?
Sue: I don't know!
Sue: I can't see Maxie or Taco!
Alex: Maybe this isn't their train.
Alex: Hey, where did our neighbor go?
Alex: She's disappeared!
Taco: What should we do, Maxie?
Maxie: Let's get off here.
Taco: Poor Alex and Sue.
Taco: What if they are still waiting for us?
Maxie: Taco! It's the witch!
Taco: Maxie! Follow me!
Maxie: Do you think the witch is following us?
Taco: I don't know!
Taco: It's so dark in here.
Taco: I can't see a thing!
Maxie: When the car stops, we have to get out.
Taco: But how? It's locked!
Maxie: Hmmm . . . I have an idea!
Man: Since we left the train station, that car has been following us!
Woman: What's that sound?
Man: I don't hear anything.
Man: I wonder what that woman wants?
Woman: Honey, that sound!
Woman: It's coming from the trunk!
Man: Let me pull over and we can check it out.
Taco: Maxie! We're stopping! Hurry up!
Man: Excuse me! I noticed you were following us.
Man: Is there a problem?
Witch: It's mine! Come back here!
Maxie: Taco! Where should we go?
Maxie: There's nowhere to go!
Taco: Just keep running!
Maxie: Can you see the witch?
Maxie: Is she gone?
Taco: No, I can't see her.
Taco: But we have to keep moving, Maxie.
Maxie: Taco! This place looks familiar.
Maxie: I think I was here before.
Taco: When? I don't remember coming here.
Maxie: That's it! That's the tree!
Taco: What tree? What are you talking about?
Maxie: The magic marker!
Maxie: I found it under this tree!
Taco: Are you sure it was this tree?
Taco: They all look the same.
Witch: Yes, yes, you are right!
Witch: It is this tree.
Witch: This is where I dropped the magic marker.
Witch: Now give me my marker! AAAAA-CHHOOOOOO!
Maxie: How do I know this marker is yours?
Witch: Because I said so!
Witch: Give it to me! AAAHHHHHHHHHHHH-CHOOOOO!
Taco: Maxie! That tree is moving!
Taco: I'm scared, Maxie!
Witch: Oh no! She's coming!
Witch: Give me my marker!
Maxie: Who's coming?
Maxie: What are you talking about?
Fairy: I am the Fairy Princess.
Fairy: The magic marker is mine!

episodes.title: The Truth About the Magic Marker

subtitle.text: Maxie: Please, Fairy Princess, please tell me about the magic marker.
Princess: Come with me and I will show you.
Taco: Maxie! We're walking inside a tree!
Taco: Is this a dream?
Maxie: No, Taco. It isn't a dream!
Maxie: This is a magic tree!
Princess: Where do you think you're going, Gisella?
Princess: I'm not through with you!
Maxie: It's so beautiful here.
Maxie: Like a fairy tale!
Princess: Welcome to the Enchanted Land of the Fairies!
Taco: Look! They all have magic markers!
Princess: Our land is a place of beauty, peace, and harmony,
Princess: just like a rainbow.
Princess: Each Fairy Princess has a marker
Princess: that represents a color of the rainbow.
Princess: Red! Orange! Yellow! Green! Blue! Indigo!
Maxie: But what about the last color?
Maxie: The rainbow isn't complete!
Princess: That's right. Because Gisella took the marker!
Princess: It didn't belong to her.
Princess: It belonged to me!
Witch: I know and I'm sorry!
Witch: I was only playing with it.
Witch: I didn't mean to lose it!
Witch: That's why I was chasing you.
Witch: I had to get the marker back.
Princess: You see, the marker belongs to the Land of Fairies.
Princess: Without that marker, we cannot have true peace and harmony.
Princess: Can you give me the marker back?
Maxie: Of course. It's your marker.
Maxie: I'm sorry I kept it.
Princess: Thank you.
Maxie: What's going to happen to her?
Princess: Gisella is sorry for what she did.
Princess: And she won't ever do it again.
Princess: Being an ugly witch was her punishment.
Taco: She . . . she . . . she was a fairy?
Taco: A beautiful fairy?
Gisella: Yes. But I turned ugly when I did bad things.
Gisella: I am never going to be bad again.
Gisella: I'm sorry. AA-CHHOOOO!
Princess: Now you know the truth about the magic marker.
Maxie: Yes, and now we are ready to go home.
Princess: Then close your eyes.
Hammie: Are Maxie and Taco still sleeping?
Heddy: SSHHH! They must be really tired.
Taco: Where am I?
Taco: Hammie? Heddy?
Maxie: We are glad to see you!
Hammie: Ouch, Maxie! You're hurting me.
Alex: You guys are finally awake!
Alex: What happened?
Sue: We were so worried about you!
Taco: Well, it all started when Betty gave the marker to Jack.
Hammie: Jack? Who's he?
Taco: He's the crocodile at the zoo.
Taco: But he moved to a new place.
Taco: So we ended up on a plane that headed to China.
Heddy: China? Are you kidding?
Maxie: Taco is telling the truth.
Alex: I'm really confused.
Sue: It doesn't matter.
Sue: The important thing is you're home now.
Sue: Everything is okay.
Taco: But how did we get here?
Taco: Who brought us back home?
Alex: We don't know either.
Alex: When I got home from school you were sleeping on my bed.
Heddy: We didn't see anything either.
Heddy: It was like . . . like . . . magic.
Taco: Wow . . . The Fairy Princess must have brought us.
Taco: I wonder where she is now.
Sue: Fairy Princess? I think you'd better explain everything to us.
Hammie: But first, we should celebrate your homecoming.
Hammie: Come on, Maxie.
Hammie: Draw us some delicious chocolate cake!
Maxie: I don't have the magic marker anymore, Hammie.
Hammie: What? What happened to it?
Hammie: Who has it now?
Maxie: The Fairy Princess has the marker.
Maxie: She is the real owner of the magic marker.
Hammie: Does that mean no more chocolate cake?
Alex: Don't worry, Hammie.
Alex: I think we have some cake downstairs.
Alex: Let's go and have some.
Taco: I enjoyed our exciting adventures together, Maxie.
Taco: I'll never forget them.
Maxie: Me neither, Taco.
Maxie: But it's good to be home.
Taco: Yes, home sweet home.
[caption_out@
